name: sheet_resistance
quantity.derivation.method: Rs = (π/ln 2)·mean(V/I), collinear four-point probe on a thin film over an insulating substrate much wider than the probe spacing (no correction factor)
quantity.uncertainty.basis: type A: s.d. of the 25 V/I readings / √n, times π/ln 2; probe-spacing and edge corrections not applied

name: resistivity
quantity.uncertainty.reason: the film thickness has no stated uncertainty
